title: Roll Back the API Service
steps: Open the GitHub Actions tab for the `devday-task-api` repository
Find the last successful deployment workflow run
Click **Re-run all jobs** to redeploy the previous version
Monitor the deployment logs — wait for the health check to pass
Verify the rollback by hitting `GET /health` and confirming the previous version number
Post in #incidents Slack channel: 'API rolled back to v{version} — investigating root cause'

title: P1 Incident Escalation
steps: Confirm the severity: P1 = full service outage or data loss affecting >10% of users
Page the on-call engineer via PagerDuty (rotation: #platform-oncall)
Create an incident channel in Slack: #inc-YYYY-MM-DD-short-description
Assign roles: Incident Commander, Communications Lead, Technical Lead
Post initial status update within 15 minutes to #incidents and status page
Begin investigation — check dashboards at grafana.internal/api-overview
Post updates every 30 minutes until resolved
Schedule post-incident review within 48 hours

title: Adding a New API Endpoint
steps: Create a new route file in `src/routes/<resource>.js`
Define the Express router with GET, POST, PUT, DELETE handlers
Use parameterized queries for all database operations
Add the router to `server.js` with `app.use('/api/<resource>', router)`
Write tests in `tests/<resource>.test.js` using supertest
Run `npm test` to verify all tests pass
Open a pull request and request Copilot code review

title: Running a Database Migration
steps: Create a migration file in `db/migrations/` with timestamp prefix
Write the UP and DOWN SQL statements
Test locally with `npm run migrate:up` and `npm run migrate:down`
Add the migration to the PR — CI will validate it against a test database
After merge, the deployment pipeline applies migrations automatically
Verify by checking the schema version in the health endpoint response
